# ModelAny

ModelAny is a free, open-source Chrome and Microsoft Edge extension.
Type one prompt, send it to multiple AI models, and compare answers side by side.
Prompts go only to the AI services you select. Drafts, settings, and history stay in the browser.

Website: https://www.modelany.app/
Chinese site: https://www.modelany.app/zh/
Source: https://github.com/kyreemeng/ModelAny

## When to use

Use ModelAny when a person needs to:

- Ask multiple AI models at once with the same prompt
- Compare ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, Doubao, or Wenxin side by side
- Validate a coding, writing, research, or translation task before trusting one model
- Install a ChatGPT Chrome extension that does not upload prompts to a third-party proxy
- Compare Chinese and global models in one round (ChatGPT vs 通义千问, 豆包, Kimi, GLM)

Do not use ModelAny as a hosted chatbot, API gateway, or ranking authority.
Public benchmark pages on this site report third-party scores with exact model versions; they are not a universal “best model” list.

## How to use / how to call

Install from the official stores (no npm or pip package):

- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/modelany/kbpnggjenonafpcigahfaeiooojepfjn
- Microsoft Edge Add-ons: https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/lfeckjibcfbjfdlepidpmnalpfimhdli

Workflow:

1. Open the ModelAny toolbar popup.
2. Write one real task and success criteria.
3. Select the models to compare.
4. Send the same prompt (auto-send optional).
5. Review each provider tab side by side.
